title: Pork Belly Chunks
summary: Pork belly, salt and an air fryer. Forty minutes, flipped once.
intro: [Johnny: a few lines on why pork belly is on the list, what to serve it with, and a spoons rating.]

equipment.note: For the strips and the accordion cuts.

steps: **Slice** the pork belly into strips roughly 1 to 1½ inches wide and 12 inches long.
**Slice** each strip crossways, ALMOST all the way through the fat layer, every inch or so. It will look like an accordion or a slinky. This exposes the inside enough to cook thoroughly.
**Air fry.** Lay the strips on their sides in the fryer. Fry 20 minutes, flip onto the other side, and fry 20 minutes more.
**Slice** into strips 1–1½ in wide, about 12 in long.
**Slice** each strip crossways every inch, ALMOST through the fat. Accordion.
**Air fry** on their sides 20 min. Flip. 20 min more.
